quests.instruction: I have a huge mouth and short round legs. I live cooling off in a river. I say "Grunt"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the hippo! It has a huge mouth and short round legs and lives cooling off in a river.
quests.funFact: Hippos can hold their breath underwater for several minutes!

quests.instruction: I have hundreds of sharp little spines. I live rustling through a garden at night. I can waddle, then curl into a tight ball. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the hedgehog! It has hundreds of sharp little spines and lives rustling through a garden at night.
quests.funFact: A hedgehog has thousands of tiny spines covering its back!

quests.instruction: I have a giant fan of colorful tail feathers. I live strutting through a garden. I can strut and spread colorful tail feathers. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the peacock! It has a giant fan of colorful tail feathers and lives strutting through a garden.
quests.funFact: A peacock fans out its colorful tail feathers to show off!

quests.instruction: I have a fan of large tail feathers. I live on a farm. I say "Gobble"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the turkey! It has a fan of large tail feathers and lives on a farm.
quests.funFact: A baby turkey is called a poult!

quests.instruction: I have one or two horns and very thick skin. I live grazing on the open plains. I say "Snort"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the rhino! It has one or two horns and very thick skin and lives grazing on the open plains.
quests.funFact: A group of rhinos together is called a crash!

quests.instruction: I have an enormous body and a giant heart. I live gliding through the deep ocean. I can glide gracefully through the water. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the blue whale! It has an enormous body and a giant heart and lives gliding through the deep ocean.
quests.funFact: Blue whales sing deep songs that can travel for miles underwater!

quests.instruction: I have black and white stripes from head to tail. I live on the grassy plains. I can gallop in a herd. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the zebra! It has black and white stripes from head to tail and lives on the grassy plains.
quests.funFact: Zebras live together in herds to stay safe!

quests.instruction: I have a black mask around the eyes and clever paws. I live exploring the forest at night. I can climb and use clever paws like tiny hands. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the raccoon! It has a black mask around the eyes and clever paws and lives exploring the forest at night.
quests.funFact: Raccoons often rinse their food in water before eating!

quests.instruction: I have webbed feet made for paddling. I live on a farm near the water. I say "Quack"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the duck! It has webbed feet made for paddling and lives on a farm near the water.
quests.funFact: A duck's feet have no nerves, so cold water doesn't bother it!

quests.instruction: I have soft whiskers and sharp little claws. I live in a cozy home as a pet. I say "Meow"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the cat! It has soft whiskers and sharp little claws and lives in a cozy home as a pet.
quests.funFact: Cats can make over 100 different sounds!

quests.instruction: I have a slim body with black spots built for speed. I live sprinting across the open plains. I can sprint faster than any other land animal. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the cheetah! It has a slim body with black spots built for speed and lives sprinting across the open plains.
quests.funFact: A cheetah can go from standing still to full speed in seconds!

quests.instruction: This animal says "Hum"! Which one is it?
quests.question: Hum
quests.hint: Think of an animal that lives darting between bright garden flowers.
quests.explanation: Yes! A hummingbird says "Hum". It also has a tiny body and a long thin beak.
quests.funFact: A hummingbird drinks sweet nectar from flowers using its long beak!

quests.instruction: Look carefully. Which animal here is a fish?
quests.question: Fish
quests.hint: This animal has a curly tail and a horse-shaped head.
quests.explanation: Yes! The seahorse is a fish. It lives drifting near ocean seaweed.
quests.funFact: A seahorse can move each of its eyes in a different direction!

quests.instruction: I have a long flowing mane and strong legs. I live on a big open farm. I say "Neigh"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the horse! It has a long flowing mane and strong legs and lives on a big open farm.
quests.funFact: Horses can turn their ears toward any sound they hear!

quests.instruction: I have shiny orange scales and gentle fins. I live swimming in a bowl or a pond. I can swim by flicking a tail fin. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the goldfish! It has shiny orange scales and gentle fins and lives swimming in a bowl or a pond.
quests.funFact: Some goldfish can live for more than 20 years!

quests.instruction: I have long floppy ears and a fluffy round tail. I live in a burrow in the forest. I can hop very quickly. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the rabbit! It has long floppy ears and a fluffy round tail and lives in a burrow in the forest.
quests.funFact: Rabbits can hop in different directions to escape quickly!

quests.instruction: I have bright, colorful feathers. I live perched in a colorful jungle tree. I say "Squawk"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the parrot! It has bright, colorful feathers and lives perched in a colorful jungle tree.
quests.funFact: Parrots use their strong curved beaks like an extra hand!

quests.instruction: I have a very long neck and long legs. I live reaching up on the plains. I can walk with long, graceful strides. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the giraffe! It has a very long neck and long legs and lives reaching up on the plains.
quests.funFact: A giraffe's tongue can be almost as long as your arm!

quests.instruction: I have a very long trunk and big flappy ears. I live in the wild jungle. I say "Trumpet"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the elephant! It has a very long trunk and big flappy ears and lives in the wild jungle.
quests.funFact: An elephant uses its trunk like a hand to pick up food!

quests.instruction: I have sharp teeth and thick grey fur. I live roaming through the forest. I say "Howl"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the wolf! It has sharp teeth and thick grey fur and lives roaming through the forest.
quests.funFact: A wolf pack works together to take care of its pups!

quests.instruction: I have eight legs and a silky web. I live weaving a web in the garden. I can crawl and spin silk. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the spider! It has eight legs and a silky web and lives weaving a web in the garden.
quests.funFact: Most spiders have eight eyes, not just two!

quests.instruction: I have scaly skin and a long tail. I live sunbathing on a warm desert rock. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the lizard! It has scaly skin and a long tail and lives sunbathing on a warm desert rock.
quests.funFact: A lizard often suns itself on a rock to warm up its body!

quests.instruction: A group of blue whales has a special name. What is it?
quests.question: Blue Whale
quests.hint: Think about where blue whales usually live: gliding through the deep ocean.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of blue whales is called a pod. They like to stay together gliding through the deep ocean.
quests.funFact: A blue whale's heart is about the size of a small car!

quests.instruction: I have skin that can change color. I live hiding among jungle leaves. I can creep slowly along branches. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the chameleon! It has skin that can change color and lives hiding among jungle leaves.
quests.funFact: A chameleon can move each of its eyes in a different direction!

quests.instruction: I have a curved fin and a playful smile. I live leaping through ocean waves. I say "Click"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the dolphin! It has a curved fin and a playful smile and lives leaping through ocean waves.
quests.funFact: A dolphin uses clicking sounds to find food underwater!

quests.instruction: I have long legs and the biggest eyes of any land animal. I live running across the open plains. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the ostrich! It has long legs and the biggest eyes of any land animal and lives running across the open plains.
quests.funFact: An ostrich lays the largest egg of any bird!

quests.instruction: I have sharp teeth and thick grey fur. I live roaming through the forest. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the wolf! It has sharp teeth and thick grey fur and lives roaming through the forest.
quests.funFact: Wolves can trot for many miles without getting tired!

quests.instruction: I have a curly, spiral-shaped shell. I live inching along a garden leaf. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the snail! It has a curly, spiral-shaped shell and lives inching along a garden leaf.
quests.funFact: A snail carries its own home in the form of a curly shell!

quests.instruction: I have tall branching antlers. I live grazing quietly in the forest. I can leap and run gracefully. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the deer! It has tall branching antlers and lives grazing quietly in the forest.
quests.funFact: A deer's big ears can turn to catch sounds from any direction!

quests.instruction: Look carefully! Which animal has long curved claws and a very calm pace?
quests.question: Long curved claws and a very calm pace
quests.hint: This animal usually lives hanging from a rainforest branch.
quests.explanation: That's right! The sloth has long curved claws and a very calm pace. You can find it hanging from a rainforest branch.
quests.funFact: A sloth only needs to come down from its tree about once a week!
